node.title: How to avoid decoding string to utf-8.
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hi Monks

I have two strings,

  1. is properly decoded and encoded in utf-8
  2. this one works only when using decode utf-8, but while decoding this one, first one get decoded too which is not necessary.
so, my question how to avoid string 1 getting decoded and only string 2 gets decoded in utf-8.
is there any way we can check if string needs decoding in utf-8.

Thank you.
